1062326009903.descriptionHtml:
The BodyJ4You 37PC Ear Stretching Kit is a 37-piece surgical stainless steel gauge set plus aftercare balm that takes stretched lobes from 14G to 00G, with matching tapers and single flare tunnels in all 9 sizes and O-rings included.

Key Facts

  • Product type: Ear stretching kit (tapers and tunnels)
  • Brand: BodyJ4You
  • Pieces: 37 (aftercare included in the count)
  • Gauge range: 14G (1.6mm) to 00G (10mm)
  • Sizes: 14G (1.6mm), 12G (2mm), 10G (2.4mm), 8G (3.2mm), 6G (4mm), 4G (5mm), 2G (6mm), 0G (8mm), 00G (10mm)
  • Material: Hypoallergenic surgical stainless steel, mirror polished
  • Tunnel style: Single flare tunnels: a lip on one side, smooth on the other, held in place by O-rings
  • Aftercare: Natural ear stretching balm made with jojoba, castor and plant-based oils, 0.35 oz (10g) reusable metal tin
  • Colors available: Silver, Black, Gold, Rainbow

What's Included

  • Surgical stainless steel tapers in 9 sizes, 14G to 00G
  • Matching single flare tunnels in the same 9 sizes
  • O-rings for the tunnels
  • 1 natural ear stretching balm, 0.35 oz (10g) reusable metal tin

Variants

  • Silver: silvertone steel finish
  • Black: black steel finish
  • Gold: goldtone steel finish
  • Rainbow: rainbow steel finish

Features

  • Every size from 14G to 00G with no half-size gaps, so one kit covers a full stretching path from first stretch to goal size.
  • Each single flare tunnel has a lip on one side and a smooth side that slides through the lobe; an O-ring secures it from the back.
  • Mirror-polished surgical stainless steel is lightweight, durable and easy to clean for all-day wear.
  • The balm is made with jojoba, castor and plant-based oils to condition lobes and keep skin soft and flexible, with no synthetic lubricants.

How to Use

Apply balm to a clean lobe whose piercing is fully settled. Slide the taper through gradually, then follow it with the matching tunnel. Re-apply aftercare daily and wait 4-6 weeks before moving up a size. Mild pressure is normal; if it hurts, stop and give the lobe more time.

Use Cases

  • Beginner ear stretching from 14G
  • Dead stretching one size at a time up to 00G (10mm)
  • Gauges for men and women who want a matching single flare look

Care and Safety

The steel jewelry is easy to clean. Never force a stretch.

Frequently Asked Questions

What sizes are in this kit?

The BodyJ4You 37PC Ear Stretching Kit covers 9 sizes from 14G (1.6mm) to 00G (10mm), each with a taper and a matching tunnel.

What material is the jewelry?

The tapers and tunnels in the BodyJ4You 37PC Ear Stretching Kit are hypoallergenic surgical stainless steel with a mirror-polished surface.

How do single flare tunnels stay in?

Each tunnel in the BodyJ4You 37PC Ear Stretching Kit has a lip on the front and a smooth back end. You slide it through from the front and roll the included O-ring on behind the lobe to hold it in place.

Is aftercare included?

Yes. The BodyJ4You 37PC Ear Stretching Kit includes a 0.35 oz (10g) natural stretching balm in a reusable metal tin, made with jojoba, castor and plant-based oils. A little goes a long way.

How long should I wait between sizes?

With the BodyJ4You 37PC Ear Stretching Kit, wait 4-6 weeks before sizing up and re-apply aftercare daily. Mild pressure is normal, but never force a stretch.

Which color should I choose?

All colors of the BodyJ4You 37PC Ear Stretching Kit share the same sizes, steel and tunnel style; only the finish differs.
